notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33266934/f81174912766de142b72a7f0f15095d8aab41f50.gif[/img]

Hi, we apologize for not doing this update in time.
Due to the collapse of our studio.

And so, what's in the update?

• New playing cards, now there are twice as many!
• New levels, doubled the amount!
• Added save current level!

Enjoy game: steamhappy:
